answer_1.quote: Infusing emotions into dialogue systems can make conversational agents more human-like and benefit the interaction between human and machine.

answer_2.quote: For automatic evaluation, we mainly choose four kinds of metrics: 1) Embedding scores (Average, Greedy, Extrema and Coherence); 2) BLEU scores; 3) Dist-1, Dist-2; and 4) Emotion-acc, Emotion-word.

answer_4.quote: a human evaluation is conducted to better analyze the quality of generated responses. First, we randomly sample 200 queries from the test set. ... Then, we send the triples of (query, response, emotion) to three human annotators without order, and require them to evaluate each response on both content level and emotion level independently.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators evaluate responses on content level (fluency, coherence, meaningfulness) using a 3-scale rating and emotion level (reveals desired emotion) using a 2-scale rating.
